description: This file defines the NotesProvider class, which manages the notes state in a Flutter application. It handles loading, filtering, adding, updating, deleting notes, and provides access to individual notes by ID.

classes.name: NotesProvider
classes.description: A ChangeNotifier class that manages a list of notes, providing methods for CRUD operations, filtering, and notifying listeners of state changes.

methods.name: loadNotes
methods.description: Loads notes from the database and updates the internal list, notifying listeners.

methods.name: filteredNotes
methods.description: Returns a filtered and sorted list of notes based on search query, category, and sort order.

methods.name: addNote
methods.description: Inserts a new note into the database and reloads the notes list.

methods.name: updateNote
methods.description: Updates an existing note in the database and reloads the notes list.

methods.name: deleteNote
methods.description: Deletes a note by ID from the database and reloads the notes list.

methods.name: getNoteById
methods.description: Retrieves a note by its ID, returning null if not found.
